← Reading Habit Coach

Made for a little more reading time.

A native Kotlin reading companion for compatible Fire tablets and Android devices.

A tablet-friendly experience

Portrait layouts use bottom navigation. Wider landscape layouts use a side navigation panel and spacious columns. Android font scaling and dark appearance are supported.

Compatibility before promises

This early build requires Android API 26 or later and does not depend on Google Play Services. Readium and installed system services determine document and voice capabilities. A full Fire device matrix and Appstore certification are still pending.
